pages.text: Soulstone is a special kind of stone that spawns in the Nether. It generates in large veins at all Y levels. $(br2)Soulstone is a decorative block with many variants. It is also required to create $(l:souls/witherproof_blocks)Witherproof Blocks$().
It can also be smelted into Soul Dust, which has many uses as well.
